## Recent Reflexion (last 2 sessions)

### S166 — tier-3 tower + six units (PROTOCOL 43), the spawner-portal bug (fixed twice), 24 boss art seeds
- **A stale docblock is the bug, waiting.** The owner's "dark background is OVER the primitives"
  traced to a docblock claiming the layer was the first added to the stage; it had since moved above
  the fog, and a note one screen down said so.
- **Distrust agent SIDE EFFECTS, not just agent CLAIMS.** A read-only discovery agent wrote a fake
  `CreatureType` into the tree to run a probe and left it. An MCV binding that pins a *semicolon*
  caught it.
- **The guards caught me twice.** `registerAll.test.ts` exposed that its own regex is non-greedy AND
  digit-blind. Widen the guard rather than rename what it failed to see.
- **A negative control found MY OWN test vacuous** — every case I picked was aspect-matched, so the
  term I thought I was testing was zero.
- **Re-run before you fix the product.** My portal fix broke CI; the failing test's own diagnostic
  says not to fix the product from that signal. Re-ran, it reproduced, then I changed code.
- **Three prompts for three states is three buildings.** When output must be a variation of prior
  output, the prior output is an INPUT — `refImages`, not a re-description.
- **A reported defect is a sample, not the population.** He named the zombie set; the same drift was
  in the naga set he had already approved.
